purpose: Original-image measurements for the user-selected front-master-02. This is landmark data, not a drawing function or a new authored head. Other angles remain unapproved design references.

source.coordinateConvention: Source pixel space, x right / y down. Pixel samples are centred at index+0.5; manually named crown/chin anchors retain the integer coordinates provided during review.

approvalScope: The user selected this front head shape. Neither head-skins-04, turnaround-test-03, a generated extraction, nor a future rig is thereby approved.

registration.referenceFrameStatus: Review estimate: visible head width about 587 and height about 565. This frame is not a clip rectangle; measured points may extend slightly beyond it.
registration.normalizedCoordinateRule: u=(x-334)/587; v=(y-180)/565. Do not clamp measured points to [0,1].
registration.shapeAuthority: Use the selected image points and combined head/ear envelope for rest geometry. The 633/532 aspect ratio of the clean 04 cut is not the target head aspect ratio.

approvedFrontContour.pointOrder: Each side runs from crown down to chin; right is not silently mirrored from left.

inferredConnections.scope: Crown endpoint at [628,180] is a named geometric apex. Raster alpha at row 180 forms a short near-horizontal top run; a curve through the apex and the measured next row is a reconstruction, not an exact raster trace.

White head and white ear roots share one silhouette. The selected source cannot identify a separate head alpha boundary here. Connect only inside the registered ear-root cover; judge the visible union against combinedHeadEarEnvelope. Do not call this hidden connection measured or expose it as a notch.
The middle shallow chin meets the white neck/body. Central chin [628,745] is a visual anchor, not an alpha edge. Preserve the shallow lower-face line and place its completion under the neck.

interpolationNotes: These samples are measurements, not Bezier handles. Use a shape-preserving interpolant; do not allow cubic overshoot to create a V indentation.
A higher sampling density does not resolve the hidden ear/head separation. Keep roots and head on the same registered rest coordinates.
All CPU estimates precede a real raster composition and do not certify the final silhouette or any animation.

combinedHeadEarEnvelope.purpose: Visible union around the crown/ear shoulder. These rows must not all be relabelled as the separate head boundary.

cleanSkinSource.correspondence: For each normalized target contour row, sample 04 using its own contour.rows left/right UV boundaries. Target xy comes from the selected 02 contour, independently of 04 UV aspect. Match the facial details to the selected 02 coordinates separately.
